category_title: Elementary student with Duchenne muscular dystrophy exhibiting task-avoidant and attention-seeking disruptive behaviors
minimal_context: Philip is in the school yard during break time while his classmates are starting a game of soccer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The bell just rang for break time. You can go out to the school yard now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Follows the classmates outside and intrudes on their soccer game, trying to grab the ball to get their attention)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Philip, please let them play their game.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I want to play! (Stands in the middle of the field, annoying the other children)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to figure out how to join in with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Falls on the ground) You didn't invite me to play with you! (Cries loudly and yells at his classmates)
